Sumangala Hegde

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, no24, Apollo Pharamcy building, 60 feet road, jc nagar, 560086

sumangalah24@gmail.com

WEBSITES AND SOCIAL LINKS

LinkedIn:

https://www.linkedin.com/in/sumangala-hegde-4536a920a

SUMMARY

Finance professional with 7 years of experience in investment accounting, specializing in trade lifecycle, reconciliations, and corporate actions. Demonstrated success in delivering accurate reporting and managing high-volume transactions efficiently. Experienced in IBOR and month-end close processes. Committed to improving operational efficiency and maintaining strong stakeholder relationships.

EXPERIENCE INVESTMENT ACCOUNTING – SME | Mar 2022 — Mar 2026

AXA Global Business Service - Bangalore

Managed daily trade booking and tracking for a diverse portfolio of asset classes, including Fixed Income, ABS, MBS, Loans, Term

Deposits, and FX, ensuring 100% accuracy and timely execution.

Processed complex structured securities transactions, including factor updates, paydowns, and nominal interest bookings,

maintaining rigorous data integrity.

Executed corporate action bookings, dividend verifications, and security transfers in strict adherence to client instructions and

regulatory requirements.

Oversaw comprehensive accounting for Private equity (alternative investments), including precise handling of capital calls,

reductions, and return of capital.

Monitored and reconciled collateral movements and repo transactions, implementing necessary adjustments to mitigate risk and

ensure financial accuracy.

Processed and validated SWIFT trade messages (MT54x/MT56x) to ensure accurate trade capture, settlement, and reconciliation.. Conducted daily General Ledger (GL) to Bank reconciliations, Cash reconciliation consistently resolving discrepancies within

established deadlines to maintain financial control.

Independently managed the month-end close process, ensuring accurate sign-off on all cash and trade activity for timely reporting.

Streamlined cross-departmental communication, reducing resolution time by 20% and resolved breaks and exceptions, optimizing

operational workflows.

Record and reconcile collateral movements to ensure alignment with bank positions, maintaining accurate tracking of pledged

assets and margin requirements

Created, updated, and maintained Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and delivered training sessions for new joiners and

existing team members

INVESTMENT BANKING SENIOR ANALYST | Apr 2020 — Nov 2021 State Street Corporation - Bangalore

Executed daily trade verification and settlement analysis, strictly adhering to trade lifecycle controls to ensure operational integrity. • Reduced reconciliation discrepancies by 30% of securities, cash, positions, capital, and stock variances, maintaining high accuracy standards.

Managed extensive daily and monthly transaction closures for fixed income securities, ensuring precision and compliance throughout the process.

Executed bulk trade uploads for high-volume transactions while ensuring data accuracy and timely processing within SLA. • • Performed critical income and maturity validations, including proactive negative income checks, to safeguard financial reporting. Performed pre-upload validations by verifying trade attributes, security details, counterparty information, and settlement instructions before system upload.

Conducted trade enrichment by updating missing trade attributes such as SSI, broker details, settlement instructions, market identifiers, and trade economics to ensure complete trade records.

Used TLM (Transaction Lifecycle Management) to investigate and resolve trade breaks, reconciliation exceptions, and settlement mismatches..

.

TRANSACTION PROCESSING ASSOCIATE | Feb 2019 — Mar 2020

Accenture - Bangalore

Streamlined transaction processes, boosting efficiency by 30%. Achieved 99% accuracy in data entry and transaction processing. Enhanced customer satisfaction through timely transaction resolutions. Implemented new tracking systems, reducing errors by 25%.

Trained new associates, improving team performance and morale. Analyzed transaction data, identifying trends to drive sales strategies.

EDUCATION Karnataka University - Dharwad | Bachelor of Commerce

| 2015 - 2018

Dept. Of Pre-University Education - Sirsi | Higher Secondary Education

| 2013 - 2015

SKILLS

Cash & Position ReconciliationFixed Income & Equity

Instruments Knowledge

Portfolio Valuation (NAV Calculation)Fund Accounting

Trade Lifecycle ManagementAdaptability to the changing

environment and situa

Self Confidence and ability to deal with criticalMS-Office

(Word, Excel, PowerPoint Power BI)

LANGUAGES

English

Kannada

Hindi

ACHIEVEMENTS

Led employee engagement and knowledge-sharing initiatives, improving team collaboration and workplace inclusivity. Supported organizational programs aimed at improving employee experience and collaboration. Completed year-end closing 15% faster than team average while maintaining 100% accuracy. Earned client recognitions for timely resolution of complex queries and operational excellence.

CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENSES

Completed Certification course in Tally ERP 9.0

PERSONAL DETAILS

Date of Birth : 16-09-1997 Gender : Female

CORE COMPETENCIES

Chameleon Catalyst Empathizer Optimist Deliverer
